svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Backup and restore with AWS Backup
svg.desc: Backup and restore with AWS Backup. 9 components in 7 groups. Connections: Protected resources to AWS Backup (back up); AWS Backup to Backup vault (store); Backup vault to Backup vault (copy); Backup vault to AWS Backup Vault Lock (copy); Protected resources to Backup vault (restore); AWS Key Management Service to Backup vault (encrypt).

text.tspan: BACKUP AND RESTORE WITH AWS BACKUP
A backup plan protects production, copies each recovery point to a second Region and to a locked vault in a backup account, and restores into production
